newsitem.title: CHINA: Mitsubishi Elec in $17.8 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Elec in $17.8 mln China deal.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp has signed a $17.8 million contract to build to build a transformer for China's second-biggest hydro-electric power station, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
The transformer is the the last major piece of mechanical and electrical equipment purchased by the Ertan power station through international bidding over the last five years, Xinhua said.
About $200 million, part of a $930 million World Bank loan being used in the project, has been used to purchase equipment.
The Ertan hydropower station, in central Sichuan province, would have a total installed capacity of 3,300 megawatts and annual electricity production of 17 billion kilowatt hours, Xinhua said.
